storyCards.headline: Sweetest Thing: A Cultural Moment Captured on Record
storyCards.fact:
U2's "Sweetest Thing" reached #63 on the Billboard Hot 100.

The song peaked at #63 on the Billboard Hot 100 and spent 17 weeks on the chart.

Graph compilation anchor: "The Best Of 1980-1990/The B-Sides" (1998) — not the song's original release year.

Album: The Best Of 1980-1990/The B-Sides (1998).
